title: Maximize Sum Of Array After K Negations
description: Given an array and an integer k, negate the smallest values k times to maximize the final sum.
pseudocode:
1: Sort array in ascending order
2: Loop i from 0 to array.length - 1
3: If k > 0 and array[i] < 0:
4:   array[i] = -array[i]
5:   k = k - 1
6: Sort array again to find the new smallest value
7: If k is odd, negate the smallest element

steps.note: Sort array to easily find the smallest negative numbers.
First element is negative, k > 0, so negate it.
Second element is negative, k > 0, so negate it.
Resort to ensure the smallest element is at index 0.
k is 0, no further negations required.
